last_change.summary: Added an optional executable_binding field to ExperimentStochasticControlModel and a stochastic_draws archival draw-provenance list for EXP-718 (issue #274). The stochastic_draws control_id invariant now also requires the resolved control to carry an executable_binding and the draw's address.namespace/transform_id/transform_version to match that binding's namespace and admitted profile transforms. RandomStreamDrawRecordModel's outcome is now optional, with an invariant requiring it exactly when rejection_exhausted is false.
